A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 19-page versions of the same VecFormer study. Text, equations, Tables 1–2, Figures 1–10, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original FloorPlanCAD benchmark results and ablations in Tables 1–2, plus sequence-length analysis in Appendix C and qualitative evaluations.

after.justification: v2 retains the original FloorPlanCAD benchmark results, ablations, sequence-length analysis, and qualitative evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical line sampling, PTv3 backbone, line pooling, Layer Feature Enhancement, dual-branch decoder, losses, and Branch Fusion Refinement procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same FloorPlanCAD data, panoptic symbol spotting and primitive-level semantic tasks, and settings with and without prior information. No dataset or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in Tables 1a and 1b are identical, including DPSS [40]. The revised bibliography entry identifies the same existing baseline work.

E3.justification: Both retain the 6,965/810/3,827 training/validation/test split, PQ/F1/wF1 metrics, 500-epoch training budget, and prior-information settings. Sampling comparison protocols also match.

E4.justification: Table 2 retains the same sampling strategy, sampling ratio, BFR, and prior-information ablations. Appendices A–D contain identical representation comparisons, sampling-density examples, sequence-length analysis, and qualitative evaluations.

E5.justification: Reporting practices are unchanged. Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, uncertainty bars, or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples match. Table 1a reports VecFormer PQ of 88.4 without prior information and 91.1 with it in both versions; Table 2 and Appendix C results are also identical.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 and their associated mathematical definitions and reasoning are unchanged, including the representation, pooling, loss, refinement, and PQ/IoU formulations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about line-based representation, BFR, state-of-the-art performance, and the 9.6/21.2-point Stuff-PQ advantages.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning geometric fidelity, efficiency, layer priors, and robustness are identical. Section 5 retains the same limitation of uniform sampling in geometrically complex regions and proposed future dynamic sampling.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is unchanged, including optimizer, learning-rate schedule, augmentation, loss weights, batch size, and eight-A100 training hardware. No code or data access disclosure is added.

R1.justification: The same 40 works and research positioning are retained. Reference [40] still cites ArchCAD-400K; abbreviating its authors and adding arXiv:2503.22346 changes bibliographic metadata, not the cited work or its role.

P1.justification: v2 updates the arXiv version/date stamp and edits reference [40] to use an abbreviated author list and include its arXiv preprint identifier. Main-text wording, section structure, and appendix text are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10, Tables 1–2, captions, placement, and page layout are unchanged. The reference edit changes text within the existing bibliography block without reorganizing the display.

improvement.justification: v2 only updates the version stamp and metadata for an existing reference. The added identifier makes that citation more explicit, but the scientific argument, experimental evidence, technical documentation, limitations, and appendices remain unchanged, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
